subject: Post-demo recap: unit-cost scenarios, CAC sensitivity, and next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@clearwellhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap: unit-cost scenarios, CAC sensitivity, and next steps

Thanks for the time today, Anna — great discussion. Below is a concise recap from our side plus the unit-econ scenarios we promised. I kept the assumptions explicit so we can converge quickly on which bucket you want us to price against.

Call highlights (short):
- Clearwell wants a contextual summarization + Q&A feature inside clinician workflow (EHR popover).
- Primary user base: commercial pilot = 2,500 clinicians; wider rollout target = 20k clinicians over 12 months.
- Procurement target budget (initial): indicated range $10k–$25k/month on inference (you confirmed you can flex by feature if needed).

Assumptions used in model attached (cost-model-v1.xlsx):
- Avg tokens per feature invocation: 120 tokens (summary + follow-up Q&A).
- Avg invocations per active clinician per month: 22 (mix of quick checks and longer summarizations).
- Candidate pricing targets you mentioned on call: willing to consider $350–$520 per 1M tokens as a contract target depending on commitments.

Scenario examples (quick math):
- At $420 / 1M tokens (midpoint): cost per invocation = (120 / 1,000,000) * 420 = $0.0504 -> ~5 cents.
- Monthly inference cost per clinician = 22 * $0.0504 = $1.11.
- Pilot (2.5k clinicians) monthly inference = 2,500 * $1.11 = ~$2.8k.
- Full rollout (20k clinicians) monthly = 20,000 * $1.11 = ~$22.2k.

Unit-econ framing for procurement & finance (what matters):
- $/feature (per invocation) is the simplest lens to map to product metrics.
- Contribution margin post-inference = ARR/monthly revenue per user minus inference cost.
- CAC payback depends heavily on ARPU and optional premium tiers (we sketched 3 customer ARPU profiles in the workbook).

Immediate asks / next steps we propose:
1) You confirm which rollout bucket we should price: Pilot (2.5k) vs. Phase 1 (10k) vs. All (20k).
2) Procurement to share any required SOW template + expected PO timing (cc'd).
3) We'll run two binding scenarios: a) 12-month reserved capacity price (committed) and b) consumption-based tiered pricing with breakpoints at 5M / 25M / 100M tokens. We attached the model with knobs for ARPU and CAC inputs.

Attachments: cost-model-v1.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx (skeleton).

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up to walk the sheet once you have a preferred bucket.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference | reduce inference cost, preserve quality

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwellhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: unit-cost scenarios, CAC sensitivity, and next steps

Thanks, Priyom — helpful recap and appreciate the table. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) For contracting we want pricing scoped to the Pilot (2.5k clinicians) but with an option to scale to 10k after month 6 if adoption metrics hit our targets.
2) Procurement budget for a pilot is roughly $12k/month capped (we would prioritize core summarization calls, and may gate long Q&A until we see usage).
3) On the $/1M target: we can commit to a 12-month pilot at up to $450 / 1M tokens if there are clear SLAs and basic audit logs (SOC2 evidence).

Can you confirm whether $450 / 1M yields predictable monthly spend at our pilot scale (2.5k clinicians) with the invocation assumptions you used? Also looped in procurement for SOW template + vendor setup.

Thanks — happy to set a short follow-up for Thursday if that helps finalize numbers.

—Anna
Head of Clinical Innovation, Clearwell Health
---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@clearwellhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: unit-cost scenarios, CAC sensitivity, and next steps

Anna / team — quick confirmation from eng/costing perspective. The simple answer: yes, $450 / 1M tokens maps to a very predictable spend at the pilot scale with the provided invocation assumptions. A couple of details and optional levers that materially change the number: 

- Token reduction: moving average tokens per invocation from 120 -> 80 (prompt engineering + template reuse) reduces per-invocation cost from ~$0.054 -> ~$0.036 at $450 / 1M. That’s ~33% savings.
- Batching and KV caching: for repeated clinician context we can cache prefixes which reduces tokens for follow-ups; we model this as a 15–30% effective token reduction for power users.
- Reserved capacity vs. on-demand: a 12-month reserved commit at >=25M tokens/month typically reduces unit price by ~10–20% (we include a reserved-pricing scenario in the workbook).

Proposed commercial options to present to Clearwell: 
A) Pilot consumption (no commit): $450 / 1M, tiered breakpoints (5M, 25M, 100M) — straightforward but higher unit.
B) Pilot commit: 12-month commit priced at $375–$410 / 1M depending on commitment size and an SLA add-on.
C) Hybrid: small commit + overage at consumption tiers.

I'll run the attached cost-model with three token-per-invocation sensitivities (120, 90, 60) and return a 1-pager with the math so procurement can drop it into internal finance.

Karthik
Director, Inference Costing, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@clearwellhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearwellhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: unit-cost scenarios, CAC sensitivity, and next steps

Thanks, all — short update and proposed next steps based on your ask, Anna.

Deliverables we’ll share by Monday EOD (attached + links):
- cost-model-v1.xlsx: three sensitivity tabs (120 / 90 / 60 tokens per invocation), pilot (2.5k), scale (10k / 20k) views, and CAC-payback tab where you can tweak ARPU and CAC.
- SOW-draft.pdf: skeleton SOW for vendor/implementation that you can forward to legal.
- mutual-action-plan.docx: rollout milestones and dates to get you to production within 12 weeks.

Immediate asks for Clearwell:
1) Please confirm you want us to price to the Pilot (2.5k) with option to bump to 10k at month 6 — we will prepare both consumption and 12-month reserved options.
2) Procurement: share your SOW template + preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly).
3) If finance wants a single-line break for inference cost per clinician, we recommend using the per-invocation cost at 90 tokens as conservative estimate (sheet shows both optimist/median/pessimist).

We’ll schedule a 20-min walkthrough of the workbook on Thursday — please propose times or we’ll send a calendar invite for 10:00–10:20 PT.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: cost-model-v1.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx, SOW-draft.pdf

Onward — looking forward to locking pilot details.
